cohort: The study included 190 neonates with hyperbilirubinemia who required phototherapy, divided into blood group compatible (control) and incompatible (case) groups.
finding: Various blood group incompatibilities, especially ABO, ABO+Rh, and pure Rh incompatibility, are significantly associated with hyperbilirubinemia requiring phototherapy and longer phototherapy durations.
mod_finding: Delivery mode did not significantly influence phototherapy duration.
